description.text: Training Objectives:Training senior specialists engaged in financial business, operation and management in banks, financial institutes and other foreign-related departments, or engaged in education and research in universities and scientific research units.Core Courses:Political Economics, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Public Finance, Economics of Money and Banking, International Trade, International Finance, Security Investment, Insurance, Management of Commercial Banks, Central Banking, Theories and Practices of Investment Banks, and so on.Employment and Further Studies:Graduates work in banks, financial institutes, foreign-related departments, industrial and commercial enterprises, economic and administrative authorities, universities and scientific research units, etc. Initial employment rate is over 90%. Moreover, students have opportunities to pursue master degrees for International Trade, Finance, Regional Economics or other majors in Ningbo University.

duration.text: The Finance Engineering at Ningbo University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photo8 photos in the size of 2 inches3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Over the age of 18 and hold a valid foreign passport 2. Be in good health. 3. Grade C or 70% in English
